== Star credential ==

A '''star credential''' groups resources that a publisher asserts refer to the same entity across memory systems.

Its structure is:

<pre>
[A][B1][B2]…
</pre>

'''A''' is the centre by convention. The '''B''' resources form an unordered set. The centre is not a claim that A is more true, authoritative, or morally privileged than the other resources.

Each spoke can be understood as a same-entity assertion between the centre and another resource:

<pre>
B1 ← A → B2
</pre>

The human-readable wiki page is a presentation of the credential; the bracketed form preserves the compact machine-readable structure used by the Village Link project.

See also [[VillageLink:Village link]].
